exposure: Society for Maternal-Fetal Medicine definition of low-risk pregnancy
cohort: 1,657,495 deliveries from the 2013 Nationwide Readmissions Database, including 845,056 identified as low-risk pregnancies
finding: Hospital delivery volume was not independently associated with cesarean delivery rates in low-risk pregnancies after adjusting for patient and hospital characteristics.
mod_finding: Hospital delivery volume was not an independent predictor of cesarean delivery in low-risk pregnancies.
